# IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh

> > Institutional repository for Nicolae Testemitanu State University of Medicine and Pharmacy in Moldova, providing digital access to academic publications, research, and medical education materials.

IRMS is a DSpace-based institutional repository serving Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh, a leading medical university in Moldova. The repository organizes content across multiple academic departments including medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and public health, along with research projects and clinical guidelines.

## Key Topics

- DSpace platform
- Institutional repository
- Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh

## Core Repository Functions

- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: Home](https://repository.usmf.md): Home page for IRMS institutional repository at Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh, Moldova
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: Search](https://repository.usmf.md/advanced-search): Advanced search interface for IRMS medical sciences repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: Browsing DSpace](https://repository.usmf.md/browse): Browse interface for IRMS academic archive and digital repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: Communities and Collections](https://repository.usmf.md/community-list): Directory of communities and collections in IRMS DSpace repository

## Academic Collections

- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 1. COLECȚIA INSTITUȚIONALĂ](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/254): Institutional collection containing academic publications and research
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 2. FACULTATEA DE MEDICINĂ nr.1 / FACULTY OF MEDICINE nr.1](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/578): Faculty of Medicine nr.1 collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 3. FACULTATEA DE MEDICINĂ nr.2 / FACULTY OF MEDICINE nr.2](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/883): Faculty of Medicine nr.2 collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 4. FACULTATEA DE STOMATOLOGIE / FACULTY OF DENTISTRY](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/1): Faculty of Dentistry collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 5. FACULTATEA DE FARMACIE / FACULTY OF PHARMACY](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/72): Faculty of Pharmacy collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 6. FACULTATEA DE REZIDENȚIAT / FACULTY OF RESIDENCY](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/151): Faculty of Residency collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 7. ȘCOALA  DE SĂNĂTATE PUBLICĂ / SCHOOL OF PUBLIC HEALTH](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/873): School of Public Health collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: 8. ȘCOALA DOCTORALĂ ÎN DOMENIUL ȘTIINȚE MEDICALE / DOCTORAL SCHOOL IN MEDICAL SCIENCE](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/245): Doctoral School theses collection in IRMS medical sciences repository

## Research & Reference Collections

- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: BIBLIOTECA ȘTIINȚIFICĂ MEDICALĂ a IP USMF "NICOLAE TESTEMIȚANU"](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/248): Medical Scientific Library digital collection in IRMS repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: PROIECTE DE CERCETARE / RESEARCH PROJECTS](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/21955): Research projects collection in IRMS institutional repository
- [IRMS - Nicolae Testemitanu SUMPh: PROTOCOALE CLINICE / GUIDELINES](https://repository.usmf.md/handle/20.500.12710/10193): Clinical protocols and medical guidelines collection in IRMS
